episodes.desc: 💜🎶 We're kicking off with a fabulous song sung by our royal superstar, Purple! ✴️ What's the lesson? In this episode we revisit the colour mixing lessons from series one of Colourblocks to build a solid foundation of colour understanding to help prepare Colour Explorers for the new series. ❇️ Watch the whole series over the next few weeks only on Colourblocks on YouTube!

episodes.title: A Plate of Many Colours
episodes.desc: ❤️🍎 Red is hosting lunch and we're all invited! ✴️ What's the lesson? Colour Explorers will join the Colourblocks for lunch and learn about colour names, grouping colours together and that trying new healthy food can be tons of fun!

episodes.title: Name that Colour
episodes.desc: 🔍 Watch Pink and Brown compete in an episode of Purple's famous gameshow... Name That Colour! Who do you think will win? ✴️ What's the lesson? Along with their friends Pink and Brown, Colour Explorers will practise colour names while playing many rounds of 'Name That Colour'. The lessons get more advanced as light and dark shades and tones are introduced.

episodes.title: Colouring a Rainbow
episodes.desc: 🌈 🌧️ Join the Rainbow Chasers on a quest to find a rainbow with our epic Colouring a rainbow song! ✴️ What's the lesson? Colour Explorers and their friends Orange, Indigo and Violet, learn that colours overlap and blur in a rainbow creating inbetween colours, visually showing that there are many more colours in a rainbow.

episodes.title: Printing Crew to the Rescue
episodes.desc: 🏁🐸 The Printing Crew are back meeting Green and her frog friends. ✴️ What's the lesson? By helping the Colourblocks with printed signs, the Printing Crew show Colour Explorers that when they mix they can make lots of different colours. Colour mixing examples include Cyan and Magenta mixing to make Blue and then Cyan mixing with Yellow to make Green.

episodes.title: Deep Blue and Sky Blue
episodes.desc: ✴️ What's the lesson? Blue meets new Colourblocks that are lighter and darker versions of him. Colour Explorers see how these colours are relevant to their day-to-day lives on a colour fun adventure into the deep blue sea and then high up into the sky.

episodes.title: Orange's Gym
episodes.desc: 🍊💪 Ignite that orangey energy and come and visit Orange's gym! ✴️ What's the lesson? While trying to help Orange decorate her gym, Red and Yellow show Colour Explorers that their colours can mix to make yellowy-orange, orangey-yellow or reddy-orange! They learn that the colours they can mix are not quite the same as their friend Orange. ❇️ Watch the brand new episodes from Series 2 only on Colourblocks on YouTube!

episodes.title: Purple's Mural Makeover!
episodes.desc: 🖌️ Grab your overalls - we're heading to Purple's place to help decorate his mural. ✴️ What's the lesson? Your Colour Explorer will join Red and Blue in helping Purple decorate his mural. They will visually see that when the colours red and blue mix together that the resulting colour is less like Purple and more like a reddish-purple or bluey-purple.

episodes.title: Lime
episodes.desc: 🎶 🎤 She has a real zest for life... it's time to meet Colourblock Lime! ✴️ What's the lesson? Colour Explorers meet a new Colourblock and learn that the colour Lime is located between Yellow and Green in the colour order.

episodes.title: Return of the Sorting Express
episodes.desc: 🚂💨 All aboard! The Sorting Express is now boarding in Colourland.Toot, toot! ✴️ What's the lesson? The Sorting Express helps guide Colour Explorers in identifying and sorting in-between colours building towards an understanding of colour schemes

episodes.title: Fun with Colours
episodes.desc: 🎒 🌇 Pack your backpack! We're heading out on an adventure to explore the seas and cities of Colourland. ✴️ What's the lesson? Taking everything Colour Explorers have learnt on our colour journey so far, this episode shows Colour Explorers the many different places and times of the day where they experience colour.

episodes.title: It's a Grey day
episodes.desc: 🌧️🩶 It's a Grey rainy day which means it's time for some indoor colour fun! ✴️ What's the lesson? Showing Colour Explorers that discovering colours indoors is just as fun as being outside while touching on teaching colour saturation and less bright colours.

episodes.title: Red's Recolouring Tour
episodes.desc: 🚌❤️ The perfect tour to tick off all the landmarks, join Red as she hosts you on a guided tour of Colourland. ✴️ What's the lesson? As Red takes Colour Explorers on a tour around Colourland, she visually shows mixing lighter and darker colours, in-between colours and colour saturation.

episodes.title: A Colourful Journey
episodes.desc: 🌟 🌈 Get ready for our season finale, a Colourful journey - the song. ✴️ What's the lesson? A summary of everything the Colurblocks and Colour Explorers have learned together throughout the season. This episode concludes by showing an up-to-date colour wheel and populating the Colourblocks into the colour order.

episodes.title: One
episodes.desc: A little block falls out of the sky, meets her numberling and discovers one wonderful world, singing and counting to one. Learn all about the number 1 with Numberblock One!
episodes.descKo: 작은 블록 하나가 하늘에서 떨어져 그녀의 숫자를 만난 후 멋진 세상을 발견하고, 노래하며 숫자 일까지 세고 있습니다. 넘버블록 일으로 숫자 일에 대해 모두 알아보세요!

episodes.title: Another One
episodes.desc: One discovers it's tricky to play tennis when you're the only block in the world. She bumps into a magic mirror and meets another One, and they join forces to make Two. Learn a thing or two about adding with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일은 자기가 세상에 존재하는 유일한 블록일 때 테니스를 치는 것이 어렵다는 것을 알게 되요. 그녀는 마법의 거울과 부딪쳐 다른 숫자 일을 만나고 둘은 힘을 합쳐 숫자 이를 만듭니다. 넘버블록스로 더하는 방법에 대해 알아보아요.

episodes.title: Two
episodes.desc: Two finds a pair of magic dancing shoes and shows One that everything is better with two, singing and counting things that belong in pairs. Learn all about the number two with Numberblock Two.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 이는 마법의 댄싱 슈즈 한 켤레를 발견하고 숫자 일에게 모든 것이 둘이면 더 좋다는 것을 보여줍니다, 노래를 부르고 짝으로 되어있는 것들을 세어보면서요. 넘버블록 이로 숫자 이에 대해 모두 알아보세요..

episodes.title: Three
episodes.desc: Three arrives with a bang and a song-and-dance about her favourite number - 1, 2, 3, Everybody Look at Me! Learn all about the number three with Numberblock Three.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 삼은 쨘!하고 도착해 그녀가 가장 좋아하는 번호인 일 이 삼 (1, 2, 3)에 대한 노래와 춤을 춥니다. 모두 나를 보아요! 넘버블록 삼으로 숫자 삼에 대해 모두 알아보세요.

episodes.title: One, Two, Three
episodes.desc: Three does magic tricks with apples to show the others who goes first, who is biggest and how to surprise your number friends. Learn about simple counting, ordering and adding with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 삼은 사과로 마술 트릭을 하면서 다른 사람들에게 누가 먼저 가는지, 누가 가장 큰지, 그리고 얼마나 많은 친구들을 놀라게 할 수 있는지 보여줍니다. 넘버블록스를 사용하여 간단한 계산, 주문 및 덧셈에 대해 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Four
episodes.desc: Four is the new block on the block and he can't wait to share how much he loves to be square! Learn all about the number four with Numberblock Four.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 사는 새로운 블록이며 그가 정사각형을 얼마나 사랑하는지 공유하고 싶어 안달이 났어요! 넘버블록 사로 숫자 사에 대해 모두 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Five
episodes.desc: Five arrives to get the band together - and the party started - with a big high five! Learn all about the number 5 with Numberblock Five.
episodes.descKo: 5명이 밴드를 만들기 위해 도착했고, 빅 하이 파이브와 함께 파티가 시작되었습니다! 넘버블록 오로 숫자 오에 대해 모두 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Three Little Pigs
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks present their very own, very numbery version of the classic tale The Three Little Pigs and the Big Bad Square. Learn about adding ones and simple counting with the number friends.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스는 고전 이야기인 아기돼지 삼형제와 나쁜 네모 늑대를 응용해 만든 고유한 이야기이며 이를 숫자버전으로 보여줍니다. 숫자 친구와 함께 일(1)들을 더하고 간단한 숫자세기에 대해 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Off We Go
episodes.desc: Five and friends set off on a rhyming romp through field and forest, but they keep getting mixed up.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 오와 친구들은 운율을 맞춰 들판과 숲을 가로지르며 장난을 치는 와중에 서로 뒤섞이며 자꾸만 말썽을 피우네요! 넘버블록스를 사용하여 숫자를 순서대로 유지하고 빠진 숫자를 찾는 방법을 알아보세요.

episodes.title: How to Count
episodes.desc: It's a lovely day for a picnic, but one of the flapjacks is missing! Is there a flapjack-snaffler on the loose or has Three forgotten what Numberblocks do best?
episodes.descKo: 소풍가기 좋은 날에 플랩잭 과자 중 하나가 없어졌어요! 플랩잭 도둑이 숨어있거나 우리 넘버블록스들이 숫자 삼이 가장 잘하는 게 뭔지 잊은 것 같아요! 숫자를 세는 방법을 배우고 우리 숫자 친구들과 항상 정답을 맞혀 보세요.

episodes.title: Stampolines
episodes.desc: Three opens a stampoline park, where her friends have splatty fun making inky prints.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 삼은 스탬폴린 공원을 열었어요, 그녀의 친구들이 만들 수 있는 모든 모양의 잉크 자국을 만드는 재미있는 놀이를 할 수 있는 공원이에요. 넘버블록스로 눈에 보이는 양을 인식하는 방법을 배워보아요.

episodes.title: The Whole of Me
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks perform a song and dance all about the parts that make a whole.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스가 무엇으로 만들어졌는지 노래를 통해 보여주고 넘버블록스 전체를 구성하는 모든 부분들이 춤을 춰요. 넘버블록스를 사용하여 숫자를 더 작은 숫자로 나누는 방법을 알아보세요.

episodes.title: The Terrible Twos
episodes.desc: Tricky twins turn up - the Terrible Twos, who decide it's time to tickle their friends.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 사가 나눠지고 까다로운 쌍둥이가 나타나면서 두 배의 문제가 발생합니다:  꼭미운 두살 같죠? 친구들을 간지럽혀 조각낼 때라고 결정했네요! 숫자 블록을 사용하여 숫자가 모두 1(때로는 2)로 구성되어 있음을 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Holes
episodes.desc: Five and friends discover a hole that makes their heads fall off!
episodes.descKo: 숫자 오와 친구들은 그들의 머리가 떨어져 나가는 구멍을 발견했어요! 위아래로 세는 방법과 넘버블록스로 어떤 숫자를 더해 숫자 오를 만드는 지 배워보아요.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.desc: Five is so good at hide and seek she can find the others without looking up from her book.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 오는 숨바꼭질을 아주 잘해서 책에서 눈을 떼지 않고도 다른 사람들을 찾을 수 있습니다, 그러나 어떻게 하는 걸까요? 넘버블록스로 5를 더하는 방법을 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Six
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks make a new friend who likes to roll dice, and with Six in the mix, everything's a game. Learn all about the number 6 with Numberblock Six.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 블록에는 주사위 굴리기를 좋아하는 새로운 친구가 있고 이제 Six가 도착했으므로 모든 것이 더 재미있습니다. numberSix로 숫자 6에 대한 모든 것을 알아보세요!

episodes.title: Seven
episodes.desc: It's a rainy day for a picnic, but when lucky number Seven appears, everything comes up rainbows. Learn all about the number 7 with Numberblock Seven.
episodes.descKo: 소풍 가기엔 비 오는 날이지만 행운의 숫자 세븐이 나타나면 모든게 무지개 빛 으로 변해요. 넘버블럭 칠으로 숫자 7에 대해 모두 알아보세요!

episodes.title: Eight
episodes.titleKo: 숫자 블록 스페인어 | 전체 에피소드 | 여덟
episodes.desc: Numberland is rocked by the arrival of superblock Eight, known to his friends and fans as Octoblock. Learn all about the number 8 with Numberblock Eight.
episodes.descKo: El mundo de los numeros tiembla con la llegada del super bloque ocho, conocido entre sus amigos como bloque numero ocho. ¡Aprende todo sobre el número ocho con bloque numero ocho!

episodes.title: Nine
episodes.desc: Numberblock Nine arrives in Numberland, finds a friend in Four, sings a song about squares - and sneezes. Learn all about the number 9 with Numberblock Nine.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록 구9가 넘버랜드에 도착해서 숫자 4와 친구가 되어 정사각형에 대한 노래를 부르고 재채기를 합니다! 넘버블록 구9로 숫자 9에 대해 모두 알아보세요!

episodes.title: Ten
episodes.desc: Ten turns up to tell the Numberblocks what it's like to be a perfect ten. Learn all about the number 10 with Numberblock Ten.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십이 나타나 완벽한 10블록이 되는 것이 어떤 것인지 팀에게 말해요. 넘버블록 십으로 숫자 10에 대해 모두 알아보세요!

episodes.title: Just Add One
episodes.desc: One's idea of fun is singing, dancing and making friends by adding One. Learn to count to 10 by adding one with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일의 재미진 아이디어는 숫자 일을 추가하여 노래하고 춤추고 친구를 사귀는 것입니다! 넘버블록으로 하나씩 추가하여 10까지 세는 법을 배웁니다.

episodes.title: Blast Off
episodes.desc: Ten promises to take the others on a trip to the moon, but blasts off on her own. How will they get there? Find out which pairs of numbers add together to make ten with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십은 다른 사람들을 달 여행에 데려가겠다고 약속하지만 혼자 날아가 버립니다. 그들은 어떻게 거기에 갈 수 있을까요? 넘버블록스를 사용하여 어떤 숫자 쌍을 더하면 10이 되는지 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Counting Sheep
episodes.desc: Six tries to get the cheeky sheep to sleep and discovers that two (or three) heads are better than one. Learn how to share the number 6 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 육은 장난꾸러기 양을 재우려고 노력하고 두 개(또는 세 개)의 머리가 하나보다 낫다는 것을 발견합니다. 넘버블록스로 숫자 육6을 같은 파트로 나누는 방법에 대해서 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.desc: One explores the Double Dungeon of Doom in search of the golden apples, doubling herself all the way up to Octoblock. Learn how to double and halve numbers up to 8 with the Numberblocks
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일은 황금 사과를 찾기 위해 지하감옥을 탐험하며 옥토블럭 숫자까지 자기 자신을 두배로 늘려갑니다. 넘버블록스로 어떻게 두배로 늘리고 나뉘며 숫자 팔까지 될 수 있는지 알아보아요.

episodes.title: The Three Threes
episodes.desc: When Nine needs a helping hand, he turns into a talented trio of circus blocks, the Three Threes. Learn how to share the number 9 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 구는 도움의 손길이 필요할 때 서커스 블록에 재능이 있는 트리오인 숫자 삼의 세 세트로 변신합니다. 넘버블록스로구9를 동등하게 나누는 방법을 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Odds and Evens
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks play an exciting game of bounceball and it's the Even Tops versus the Odd Blocks. Learn about odd and even numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스가 짝수 블록 대 홀수 블록으로 재미있는 바운스볼 게임을 하고 있어요. 넘버블록스로 홀수와 짝수에 대해 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Fluffies
episodes.desc: One finds a friendly furball, two of them tickle Two and soon Numberland is full of fun and fluffies. Have fun counting and learning how to make sevens with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일은 친근한 털로 만들어진 공을 발견하고, 그 중 두 개의 공이 숫자 이2를 간지럽힙니다. 곧 넘버랜드는 재미와 푹신함으로 가득 차게되요! 넘버블록스로 숫자 칠7을 만드는 방법을 배우고 재밌게 세보세요.

episodes.title: The Two Tree
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks find a magic Two Tree and play an action-packed game of throwing twos. Learn all about adding and taking away in twos with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스는 마법의 두 나무를 찾아 두개 씩 던지는 액션으로 가득 찬 게임을 합니다. 넘버블록스를 사용하여 두배수로 더하고 빼는 방법에 대해 모두 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Numberblock Castle
episodes.desc: One, Two, Three and Four are off on a castle-exploring adventure, with a little help from the friends they make along the way. Learn how to make numbers up to 10 by adding with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 일, 이, 삼, 사는 중간에 만난 친구들의 도움을 받아 성을 탐험하는 모험을 떠납니다. 넘버블록스를 더해서 최대 숫자 십 10까지 만드는 방법을 알아보세요.

episodes.title: Ten Green Bottles
episodes.titleKo: 열 녹색 병 | 아이들을 위한 수학
episodes.desc: One of the bottles in Ten's collection accidentally falls off the wall, setting off a spectacular numbery hullabaloo. Learn to count down from ten by taking one away with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 블록으로 숫자를 세는 법을 배우고 아이들을 위한 수학을 배웁니다.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time
episodes.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about the first five Numberblocks. Learn all about the numbers one, two, three, four and five with Numberblocks One to Five.
episodes.descKo: 편안하게 앉아 있나요? 그렇다면 처음 다섯개의 넘버블록에 관한 잠자리 동화 시간 이야기를 시작할게요

episodes.title: Blockzilla
episodes.desc: Coming now to a screen near you - the monster tale of a colossal creature who really, really likes bigger numbers. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 이제 당신과 가까운 화면으로 이동합니다: 더 크고 큰 숫자를 아주 많이 좋아하는 거대한 생물의 괴물 이야기에요.

episodes.title: The Numberblocks Express
episodes.desc: All aboard for a riotous railway ride as the Numberblocks try to stop a runaway train. Learn all the number bonds up to five with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스가 폭주 열차를 막으려는 동안 소란스러운 철도 타기에 모두 탑승했어요.

episodes.title: Fruit Salad
episodes.desc: Welcome to the fabulous, fun fruit factory, where Three's super fruit-sorting machines aren't giving her any fruit. Find out how to split numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 삼에게는 과일을 제공하지 않지만... 숫자 삼의 멋진 과일 선별 기계가 있는, 멋지고 재밌는 과일 공장에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

episodes.title: Zero!
episodes.desc: When there's nothing there to count and none is the amount, nobody does it better than Zero. Learn all about the number zero with Numberblocks Zero.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 셀 것이 하나도 없고 어떤 양도 남아 있지 않을 땐, 숫자 영보다 더 잘하는 사람은 없어요.

episodes.title: Now We are Six to Ten!
episodes.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Six to Ten. Learn all about the numbers 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 편안하게 앉아 있나요? 그렇다면 넘버블록스 숫자 육에서 십까지에 관한 잠자리 동화시간 이야기를 시작할게요.

episodes.title: Numberblobs
episodes.desc: Sing along to the Numberblocks counting song with the Numberblocks' favourite friends. Learn to count to ten with the Numberblocks
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스가 가장 좋아하는 친구들과 함께 넘버블롭스 카운팅 노래를 따라 부르세요.

episodes.title: Building Blocks
episodes.desc: Learn to recognise amounts from the shapes they make with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Peekaboo!
episodes.desc: The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 친구들은 번갈아 가며 서로의 뒤에 숨으며 크고 작은 것에 관한 노래를 하고 춤을 춰요.

episodes.title: Hiccups!
episodes.desc: Every time Numberblock Nine hiccups, he falls to pieces- until the others find an unexpected cure. Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 구가 딸꾹질을 할 때마다 여러조각으로 나뉘어져요 - 다른 사람들이 예상치 못한 치료법을 찾을 때까지요!

episodes.title: What's the Difference?
episodes.desc: Seven shows the others how to be lucky: ask a number friend to jump on your head! But how do you know which friend? Find out how to tell the difference between two numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 칠은 다른 친구들에게 운이 좋아지는 법을 보여줘요. 숫자 친구에게 머리 위로 점프하라고 요청해보세요! 하지만 어떤 친구인지 어떻게 알 수 있을까요?

episodes.title: Numberblock Rally!
episodes.desc: Ten riders, ten pedal-powered cars, but only one can lift the trophy. Welcome to the Numberblock Rally! Learn about taking away with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 10명의 라이더, 10대의 페달 구동 자동차, 하지만 트로피를 들어 올릴 수 있는 사람은 단 한 명뿐이에요. 넘버블록 경기에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

episodes.title: Five and Friends
episodes.desc: When Five and friends go missing from the five-star ball, Six to Ten discover they are all Five-and-a-friend! Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 오와 친구들이 5성급 파티에서 사라지기 시작할 때, 숫자 육부터 십까지는 그들이 숫자 오와 친구들이라는 사실을 발견했어요!

episodes.title: Octoblock to the Rescue
episodes.desc: The terribly naughty Terrible Twos are making custard pies and Octoblock is all tied up. Can his friends save the day? Discover ways to make eight with the Numberblocks
episodes.descKo: 아주아주 장난꾸러기 숫자 이는 커스터드 파이를 만들고 있고 옥토블록은 숫자 이들이 꾸미는 일에 완전 묶여있네요! 그의 친구들을 과연 구해낼 수 있을가요?

episodes.title: Ten Again!
episodes.desc: The number friends all want to do different things today, so rocket Ten finds a clever way to do them all. Learn all the ways to add to ten with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 오늘은 숫자 친구들이 모두 다른 일을 하고 싶어하네요, 로켓 십은 그 모든 일을 할 수 있도록 하는 영리한 방법을 찾아요.

episodes.title: Flatland
episodes.desc: Squarey, we're not in Numberland any more! Four visits Flatland, where the flat shapes live, and becomes a real square. Learn about 2D shapes with the Numberblocks
episodes.descKo: 정사각형, 우리는 더 이상 넘버랜드에 있지 않아요! 숫자 사4는 납작한 모양들이 사는 플랫랜드를 방문하고 진짜 정사각형이 되요.

episodes.title: Pattern Palace
episodes.desc: One and her chums carefully cross the pattern puzzle paths over the magic moats to get to the Pattern Palace.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일과 그 친구들이 마법의 해자 위의 패턴으로 짜여진 퍼즐 경로를 조심스럽게 건너 패턴 궁전에 도착합니다.

episodes.title: The Legend of Big Tum
episodes.desc: A big hairy monster with a big hairy tummy who loves puzzles? Find out who is in Big Tum's tum!
episodes.descKo: 퍼즐을 좋아하는 크고 털이 많은 배를 가진 큰 털보 동물? 배불뚝이 뱃속에는 누가 있을까요?

episodes.title: Mirror, Mirror
episodes.desc: One makes a wish that the magic mirror could make lots of friends at once, and pretty soon it's pandemonium.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일이 소원을 하나 빌었는데 그 소원은 마술 거울이 한 번에 많은 친구를 사귈 수 있게 해주는 것이에요 - 그리고 곧 대혼란이 일어나요.

episodes.title: The Wrong Number
episodes.desc: It was a grey day in the big city. One was wondering where her next case would come from when a square silhouette appeared at the door... Learn how to be a number detective with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 대도시의 회색빛 날이었어요. 숫자 일이 다음 케이스가 어디에서 올지 궁금해하던 중 정사각형 실루엣이 문 앞에 나타났어요....

episodes.title: Eleven
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks make a new friend, football fan Eleven, who gets them all in training for the big match.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스는 새로운 친구를 만들었어요. 축구 팬 숫자 십일은 큰 경기를 위해 모두를 훈련시켜요.

episodes.title: Twelve!
episodes.desc: Ten and Two make Twelve, who discovers she is a super-rectangle with amazing special powers.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십과 이는 십이를 만들어요, 놀라운 특별한 힘을 가진 슈퍼 사각형이죠.

episodes.title: The Way of the Rectangle ‍
episodes.desc: Twelve shows the other Numberblocks how to put their blocks into columns and rows - and master the way of the rectangle.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십이는 다른 사람들에게 블럭을 어떻게 열과 행에 넣는지를 보여주고 직사각형이 어떻게 작동하는지 알려줘요.

episodes.title: Ride the Rays!
episodes.desc: Twelve and friends go on a spectacular space mission to save Numberland from the mysterious Block Star.
episodes.descKo: 광선을 타고 레이 캐넌 정상까지 가는 방법을 알아낼 수 있다면 넘버블록스에게 환상적인 선물이 기다리고 있어요.

episodes.title: Block Star!
episodes.desc: A fantastic treat awaits the Numberblocks if they can figure out how to ride the rays to the top of Ray Canyon.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십이와 친구들은 신비한 블록 별에게 넘버랜드를 구하기 위해 화려한 우주 임무를 수행해요.

episodes.title: Thirteen
episodes.desc: Uh-oh. Unlucky Thirteen falls apart whenever anyone mentions his name
episodes.descKo: 오 이런. 운이 없던 숫자 십삼은 누군가 그의 이름을 언급할 때마다 허물어져요.

episodes.title: Fourteen
episodes.desc: Meet extreme Fourteen, the plucky skateboarder.
episodes.descKo: 곤경에서 벗어나는 영리한 방법을 아는 용감한 스케이트 보더 숫자 십사를 만나보세요.

episodes.title: Fifteen!
episodes.desc: Agent Fifteen is here, with a smashing new way to save the day - the Super Special Secret Step Squad!
episodes.descKo: 쉿, 쉿! 요원 십오가 여기 있어요, 이 세상을 구하는 새로운 방법을 가지고요,  슈퍼 스페셜한 비밀 배수 그룹과 함께 왔답니다!

episodes.title: Tween Scenes!
episodes.desc: It's time for a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Eleven to Fifteen.
episodes.descKo: 편안하게 앉아 있나요? 그렇다면 넘버블록스 십일부터 십오까지에 관한 잠자리 동화시간 이야기를 시작할게요.

episodes.title: Steps Squads
episodes.desc: Only Step Squad can save One's balloon - but what if there's more than one Step Squad?
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일의 풍선이 날아가면 오직 배수 그룹만이 풍선을 구할 수 있습니다. 하지만 배수 그룹이 하나 이상이 있다면 어떨까요?

episodes.title: Fifteen's Minute of Fame
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks put on a talent show of terrific number tricks.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스는 멋진 숫자 트릭으로 가득 찬 장기자랑을 펼치지만 계획대로 진행되지는 않아요.

episodes.title: On Your Head
episodes.desc: When their numberlings fall off, the Numberblocks have to work out who they are.
episodes.descKo: 번호 매기기가 망가지면, 넘버블록스는 자신이 누구이며 숫자가 어떻게 작동하는지 알아내야 해요.

episodes.title: Ten's Place
episodes.desc: Welcome to Ten's Place, where trainer Ten puts her friends through their paces with a high-energy number workout. Learn about numbers that are 'ten-and-a-bit' with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십의 장소에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 트레이너 숫자 십은 그녀의 친구들에게 에너지 넘치는 숫자 운동을 시켜줍니다.

episodes.title: Balancing Bridge
episodes.desc: It's all in the balance as the Numberblocks try to make it across a very wobbly bridge. Learn about adding with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블록스가 매우 흔들리는 다리를 건너려고 할 때 모든 문제는 균형을 어떻게 잡는 지에 달려있어요.

episodes.title: Sixteen
episodes.desc: Meet the really big square who always gets the party started: Sixteen! Learn all about the number 16 with Numberblock Sixteen.
episodes.descKo: 항상 파티를 시작하는 아주 큰정사각형을 만나보세요: 십육!

episodes.title: Square Club!
episodes.desc: Things get out of hand at a Square Club meeting.
episodes.descKo: 정사각형 클럽 미팅에서는 무엇도 통제할 수 없어요! 어떤 특정한 누군가가 도착해서 문제를 해결하기 전까지는요.

episodes.title: Seventeen
episodes.desc: Meet the artist known as Seventeen, who likes to paint 17 of everything. Learn all about the number 17 with Numberblock Seventeen!
episodes.descKo: 모든 것을 17점으로 그리는 것을 좋아하는 십칠이라는 아티스트를 만나보세요.

episodes.title: Eighteen
episodes.desc: Meet Eighteen, the super speedy rectangle who was born to ride the rays.
episodes.descKo: 광선을 타기 위해 태어난 초스피드 슈퍼 사각형 열여덟을 만나보세요.

episodes.title: Loop the Loop
episodes.desc: Super rectangle Eighteen shows the others how to ride the rays on the super-duper looper. Learn about numbers that can make rectangle shapes with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 슈퍼 사각형 열여덟은 다른 친구들에게 슈퍼 롤러코스터에서 어떻게 광선을 타는 지 보여줘요.

episodes.title: Nineteen
episodes.desc: New Numberblock Nineteen discovers she's a one-off with a hidden talent for shape-shifting. Learn all about the number 19 with Numberblock Nineteen!
episodes.descKo: 새로운 넘버블록 십구는 그녀가 모양 변신에 대한 숨겨진 일회성 재능을 가지고 있다는 것을 발견해요.

episodes.title: Twenty!
episodes.desc: Are you ready for the big dance number? Numberblock Twenty struts his stuff and dances the Two Tens Tango. Learn all about the number 20 with Numberblock Twenty!
episodes.descKo: 큰 댄스 넘버를 맞이할 준비가 되었나요? 넘버블록 이십은 자신의 물건을 뽐내며 두개의 숫자 십으로 나뉘어 탱고를 춥니다.

episodes.title: Tall Stories
episodes.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about Numberblocks Sixteen to Twenty. Learn all about the numbers 16, 17, 18, 19 and 20 with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 편안하게 앉아 있나요? 그렇다면 우린 넘버블록스 십육에서 이십까지의 잠자리 동화시간을 시작할게요.

episodes.title: Flights of Fancy
episodes.desc: Rocket Ten and friends blast off into space for a rhyming adventure to visit planets 11 to 20. Explore numbers 11 to 20 with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 로켓 숫자 십과 친구들은 11번에서 20번 행성을 방문하는 모험을 위해 우주로 날아가요.

episodes.title: I Can Count to Twenty
episodes.desc: The Numberblobs challenge Twenty to a singing count-off. Who can count to 20 in the most original ways? Learn how to count up and down and in steps with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 넘버블롭스는 노래하며 숫자 이십에게 숫자 세기 시합에 도전장을 냅니다. 누가 가장 독창적인 방법으로 20까지 셀 수 있나요?

episodes.title: The Heist
episodes.desc: Can Sixteen to Twenty use their special skills to sneak past the robot guards at the Museum of Numbers? Learn about the special properties of numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 십육에서 이십까지는 과연 그들의 특별한 기술을 사용하여 로봇 경비원을 몰래 지나 숫자 박물관에 침입할 수 있을까요?

episodes.title: Sign of the Times
episodes.desc: Super-speedy Numberblock Eighteen discovers a faster way to add a number together lots of times. Learn how multiplication works with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 매우 빠른 넘버블록 열여덟은 숫자를 많이 여러 번 더하는 더 빠른 방법을 발견합니다.

episodes.title: Fun Times Fair!
episodes.desc: Super-rectangle Twelve helps the super-excited Numberblobs work out how many tokens they need for each fairground ride. Learn about multiplication with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 슈퍼 직사각형 십이는 아주 신난 넘버블롭스가 각 박람회 놀이기구를 타는데 필요한 토큰 수를 계산할 수 있도록 도와줘요.

episodes.title: The Lair of Shares!
episodes.desc: One and friends can only escape from the Lair of Shares by learning how to share and solving the puzzles inside. Find out about sharing and division with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일과 친구들은 공유하는 방법을 배우고 안에 퍼즐을 해결해야만 공유의 소굴에서 탈출할 수 있어요.

episodes.title: Terrible Twosday!
episodes.titleKo: 모든 게 두개로 나뉘는 끔찍한 날
episodes.desc: Who can stop the invasion of the Terrible Twos?
episodes.descKo: 그들은 넘버블록스를 두개씩 나누기 위해 우주에서 왔습니다. 누가 이 끔찍한 두 배수의 침략을 막을 수 있을까요?

episodes.title: Divide and Drive
episodes.desc: Three invites the other Numberblocks to her new go-kart track.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 삼은 그녀의 새로운 고-카트 트랙에 다른 사람들을 초대해요 -  운전하기 위해선 삼으로 나뉘어져야 하죠!

episodes.title: Twenty One and One
episodes.desc: Are you ready for the big dance number? Numberblock Twenty struts his stuff and dances the Two Tens Tango.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 이십과 친구들은 버스 정류장 이십번을 지날 때마다 무슨 일이 일어나는지 알아요.

episodes.title: Thirty's Big Top
episodes.desc: Welcome to the Big Top, where Thirty and friends show off their circus tricks. Learn about the numbers 30, 40 and 50 with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 정사각형은 정말, 정말 큰 정사각형을 찾아 고대 사원을 탐험해요.

episodes.title: We're Going on a Square Hunt
episodes.desc: The squares explore an ancient temple in search of a really, really big square. Learn more about square numbers with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 삼십과 친구들이 그들의 서커스 솜씨를 뽐내는 서커스에 가장 큰 텐트에 오신 것을 환영해요.

episodes.title: Land of the Giants
episodes.desc: Five and friends discover a way to make themselves ten times bigger! Learn how to count, add and think in tens with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 숫자 오와 친구들은 자신을 10배 더 크게 만드는 방법을 발견합니다!

episodes.title: Fifty!
episodes.desc: Superstar Fifty rocks out the Numberland stadium with her shining gold guitar. Learn how to count up in fives with the Numberblocks.
episodes.descKo: 슈퍼스타 오십은 번쩍이는 금색 기타로 넘버랜드 경기장을 뒤덮어요.

episodes.title: One Hundred
episodes.desc: One Hundred shows us what she's made of!
episodes.descKo: 로켓으로 작동되는 '십이 몇개 있나요' 게임에서, 숫자 육십과 친구들을 만날 시간이에요.

episodes.title: More to Explore!
episodes.desc: It's time for the grand finale but the number fun doesn't stop here
episodes.descKo: 그랜드 피날레 시간이지만 숫자의 재미는 여기서 멈추지 않아요. 탐험할 것이 훨씬 더 많아요!

episodes.title: The Big One
episodes.desc: One finds a way to keep adding ones all the way to 99
episodes.descKo: 숫자 백은 노래를 통해 본인이 뭘로 만들어 졌고 얼마나 큰 지 보여줘요.

episodes.title: One Thousand and One
episodes.desc: One wonders if anyone could be bigger than One Hundred
episodes.descKo: 숫자 일은 누군가가 과연 숫자 백보다 클 수 있는지 궁금해하고 실제로 매우 큰 숫자에 대해 생각해보아요.

episodes.title: Sixty's High Score
episodes.desc: Sixty and friends play a rocket-powered game of How Many Tens
episodes.descKo: 그랜드 피날레 시간이지만 숫자의 재미는 여기서 멈추지 않아요. 탐험할 것이 훨씬 더 많아요!

episodes.title: Your Turn (aka 'Differences')
episodes.desc: It's time for some bouncy fun as the Numberblobs take over the show. Learn about number lines, comparing numbers and more with the Numberblobs

episodes.title: Now You See Us
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks discover a magic spell that makes them all invisible. Uh-oh! Learn how to write numbers with Numberblocks Zero to Nine

episodes.title: Ten's Top Ten!
episodes.desc: Ten presents a rundown of the top hit songs in Numberland. Learn number bonds to six, seven, eight, nine and ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: What's My Number?
episodes.desc: Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.

episodes.title: Fun Times One Times Table
episodes.desc: One goes in search of the legendary One Times Table. Sing along and learn the One Times Table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: The Many Friends of Twenty
episodes.desc: Twenty enters the Pattern Palace to find out who his Twenty-friends are. Learn about number bonds to 20 with the Numberblocks

episodes.title: Ten Vaulting
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks compete in the finals of the Ten-vaulting contest. Learn about adding past ten with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Twoland
episodes.desc: What if Two was the first Numberblock? Imagine that! Learn about even numbers up to 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Two Times Shoe Shop
episodes.desc: Two discovers a magical shoe shop and the even more magical Two Times Table. Sing along and learn the two times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Odd Side Story
episodes.desc: How do the Odd Tops and Even Blocks work out who's the best? By dancing! Learn about odd and even numbers up to 20 with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: How Rectangly!
episodes.desc: Twenty-One helps some new friends find out how many rectangles they can make. Learn about the numbers 23 and 24 and explore arrays with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Rectangle Racers
episodes.desc: At the Rays Track, Twenty-Four is ready to race all day and all night! Learn about the different arrays numbers can make with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: The Team Factor
episodes.desc: Welcome to the Team Tag Arena for another exciting match! Who will be left standing? Learn about numbers that can split into equal parts with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Hidden Talents
episodes.desc: Twenty-Six enters Fifteen's Talent Show... and finds some hidden talents! Learn about the number 26, and how it splits into two thirteens with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Making Patterns
episodes.desc: Twenty-Seven and Twenty-Eight explore the new Pattern Wall at the Gallery. Learn about the numbers 27 and 28 and explore number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Now In 3D (aka 'Octonaughty Returns')
episodes.desc: Octonaughty returns with a whole new dimension of naughtiness. This calls for a whole new dimension of superhero! Learn about cubes, and other ways of arranging blocks in three dimensions with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Club Picnic
episodes.desc: There are so many clubs for Numberblocks to belong to – it's time for Twenty-Nine to figure out where he belongs! Learn about grouping numbers by numerical properties with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Circus of Threes
episodes.desc: Roll up, roll up, roll up as the spectacular Three Times Table puts on a show to remember. Learn the three times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Too Many Threes
episodes.desc: Three's attempts to hide in the Clubhouse get increasingly tricky in a slapstick comedy of Threes! Learn which numbers are multiples of three, with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Figure It Out
episodes.desc: Twenty-One reveals her six-step plan for figuring out Numberblocks - and takes some friends along for the ride. Learn different ways to explore the properties of a number with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Snow Day Doubles
episodes.desc: It's Numberblocks on ice as Thirty-Two and friends have fun halving and doubling in the snow. Learn about doubling and halving with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Steps Versus Squares
episodes.desc: The annual Steps vs Squares treasure hunt doesn't quite go to plan when a new Numberblock joins in. Learn about square numbers and number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Puzzle Square
episodes.desc: Puzzle-master Thirty-Six challenges the others to find a way into Puzzle Square by opening locks with Numberblocks. Learn about solving problems with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Four On The Floor
episodes.desc: Four and friends bust some big moves on the dance floor with the Four Times Table. Learn the four times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Sky High Fives
episodes.desc: Five gets ready to perform at the Tower of Rock with a little help from the Five Times Table. Learn the five times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: One Giant Step Squad
episodes.desc: Meet Fifty-Five, the step squad leader and rocket ship captain who's always ready to blast into space. Learn about adding and number patterns with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Square on the Moon
episodes.desc: The big squares set out to land a square on the moon using square power alone. Learn about big square numbers with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Heroes with Zeroes
episodes.desc: When there's trouble in space, Ten and the Ten Times Table rocket to the rescue. Learn the ten times table with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: What If? (aka 'Asking Questions')
episodes.desc: What if there was a way to explore every possible question? Imagine that! Learn the power of asking questions with the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: 100 Ways to Leave the Planet
episodes.desc: It's time for the biggest adventure of all – there's a whole universe to explore. Get ready to be a number explorer with everything you've learned from the Numberblocks.

episodes.title: Painting by Numbers
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks are painting each other on their canvases but Three has painted Two with one too many blocks. Realising her mistake she casts a spell and disguises herself as Two,she learns no matter what the colour of your blocks is, it’s the number of blocks that really matter.

episodes.title: Leap Blob
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks and Numberblobs have found the perfect place for a picnic, but have to cross a swamp to reach the other side. The Numberblocks carry the Numberblobs on their back, whilst learning to subitise, counting in twos, threes and fours.

episodes.title: Ice and Dice
episodes.desc: One, Two and Three are having a lovely day at the beach, and are all keen to use the ice cube machine to cool their water but can’t decide which one of them should go. They encounter Six’s dice machine to help decide the fairest way with a roll of the dice. Enjoy the new Numberblocks Episodes, have fun and learn maths the fun way!

episodes.title: Go Go Domino
episodes.desc: One, Two, Three, Four and Five are playing dominoes in the Pattern Palace. The aim of the game is to reach the golden double six domino by building a path of dominoes along the way. Each level of the game contains different patterns, the first level has dot patterns, the second level contains numerals, level three features blocks in the form of numbers and level four contains colourful pie charts all the way until they reach the golden double six domino and win a prize. Enjoy the new Numberblocks Episodes, have fun and learn maths the fun way!

episodes.title: Ten in the Bed
episodes.desc: It’s a starry night in Numberland, Ten is putting the Numberblobs to sleep on a 10-frame bed, with a special version of the nursery rhyme ‘Ten in the Bed’. At first, the Numberblobs all roll over and fall out, one at a time, each time counting how many Numberblobs are left on the ten-frame bed. Embarking on an epic ride the bed turns into a rocket with Ten joining the rocket race and blasting up into space, and narrowly avoiding an asteroid. The Numberblobs abort the bed and use Ten as their bed, as she safely transports them back to Numberland and finally sends them to sleep.

episodes.title: Shape Party
episodes.desc: Four and Two are invited to a Shape Party in Flatland, as they dive into flatland they meet a variety of 2D shapes and learn all about their properties. They meet circles, different sized triangles, quadrilaterals and many more. All leading to an impressive shape dance.

episodes.title: Can we have our ball back?
episodes.desc: One and Four are playing a game of football with Two and Three, set against the backdrop of Flatland. Four boots the ball into Flatland it turns into a small red circle, awakening Flatland Four who explores the surfaces of the 3D Numberblocks. With his new findings, he learns to make 3D shapes using 2D shapes i.e. six squares joined together make a cube or a series of triangles help to make a pyramid. Eventually, the Numberblocks learn more about shapes and how to get their ball back from a circle to a sphere.

episodes.title: Cuboid Castle
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks are building a play fort for the Numberblobs using a series of cubes and cuboids and learning about solid 3D shapes. They complete a magnificent play fort, only to realise they have forgotten about the pyramids and prisms expansion pack, with Three reading out the instructions they learn to build a see-saw and complete the play fort, only to find the Numberblobs have more fun playing with an empty cardboard box.

episodes.title: On my way to the Numberblock Fair
episodes.desc: One is on her way to Numberblock Fair with a map to help get her there. As she begins her journey she discovers the map has disappeared. Two starts her off, with the use of positional language, directing her to go over a bridge and turn left at a track. One soon gets stuck again, and meets Three, who directs her using more positional language and reiterating the learns of left and right. One finally makes it to Numberblock Fair, and meets her friends there, only to discover they used the shortcut!

episodes.title: Octoblock and the Path of Justice
episodes.desc: Octonaughty is up to another prank in the town centre and Octoblock must track him down, using a map from Octocomputer. The map gives him an overview of the whole town and he learns to line the map up with what he sees physically and uses that to locate Octonaughty. When the two meet, Octonaughty grabs hold of a rubber duck and using his resizing ray, makes the duck ginormous with the ambition of making the biggest bubble bath, ever he dashes off to Triangle Lake. Octoblock needs a shortcut this time and to use his map again, on route he finds the resizing ray and locates Octonaughty along with the giant rubber duck. Octoblock saves the day, resizes the duck and a very frustrated Octonaughty.

episodes.title: Five's Handy Shop
episodes.desc: Five has a handy new shop hoping to get lots of new customers. Her first customer is One, who wants to buy some items and learns about the value of items versus the cost of them. Soon comes Nine, who wants a bunch of flowers, costing nine pennies, with the help of Five’s handy coin machine, she changes five penny coins into one five penny coin, making it easier to carry. Whilst Eleven learns about higher value coins, as he has so many coins to carry. Five is happy to have had a successful day at her new shop.

episodes.title: As tall as the sun
episodes.desc: Six and her friends are growing sunflowers, but some are taller than others. Three claims to have one as tall as the sun, but Sixteen comes along to contest that claiming she has grown the tallest one. Using a ladder, they measure who’s sunflower is the tallest.

episodes.title: Feeding Time
episodes.desc: It’s feeding time for Blockzee, and the Numberblocks must transport some block fruit across the jungle to feed her. However, their rucksacks all have different amounts of blockfruit in them. With a pair of balancing scales they weigh the blockfruit and work out how to even out their rucksacks.

episodes.title: Rockets and Rekenreks
episodes.desc: Ten is launching her rocket rides into space for various characters, using a rekenrek, an object with five red beads and five white beads. The rekenrek helps calculate how many beads are needed per rocket ride, and translates that value into pennies, including helping to calculate change. The decablobs, from planet ten arrive, but Ten needs a bigger rekenrek to work out the cost of their journey. Using a bigger rekenrek, they work out a bigger value of beads and calculate that into pennies, launching another great rocket ride for the decablobs.

episodes.title: The Pattern of patterns
episodes.desc: Set in the pattern palace, Six sings a song, telling us all about the different types of pattern all around us. Patterns, can you spot them all?

episodes.title: Grid Unlocked
episodes.desc: In this episode Fifteen, the Super Special Secret Step Squad and the Times Tables use the power of commutativity (swapping numbers in a multiplication sentence) to solve a jet-powered problem.

episodes.title: Friendly Fours’ Beach Day
episodes.desc: Explore the world of fours with Four! 💚 Created to help children learn how the four times table works, in our NEW episode, Friendly Fours’ Beach Day, Four uses the Magic Mirror to create more Numberblocks. Can your little one help him sort the Friendly Fours into their right beach huts?

episodes.title: All-star Line-up
episodes.desc: ⭐ All-Star Line-Up ⭐ Watch the Family of Five for an all-star performance! 🎸 Watch the Numberblocks overcome obstacles together, teaching your child addition, problem-solving, teamwork and the five times table. It's the perfect way to kick-start their day!

episodes.title: Rescue Racers
episodes.desc: 🆕 NEW NUMBERBLOCKS! 🆕 Meet Forty-eight and Forty-two in Rescue Racers. Join their number fun adventure as they figure themselves out! 🏁

episodes.title: The Rolling Sixes
episodes.desc: Join the Six Times Table in a game show to learn all about her team, the Rolling Sixes.

episodes.title: Remix the Sixes
episodes.desc: Meet the Six Times Table as she sings about all the Numberblocks who are part of her team.

episodes.title: Grid Games Galore
episodes.desc: Meet Fifty-four and Fifty-six in Six's board game club, and learn how to tell them apart!

episodes.title: The Rainbow Makers
episodes.desc: Join Sixty-three as he discovers his rainbow style when he meets the Rainbow Sevens.

episodes.title: Sail the Seven Seas
episodes.desc: Sing along with Seven Times Table as he collects his crew from Seven to Seventy.

episodes.title: We Need Another Hero
episodes.desc: The heroes of the Eight Times Table are assembled by Octoblock to help save the day.

episodes.title: Super Eights Assemble
episodes.desc: 🆕 Super Eights Assemble! 🔊🦸 Meet the super Eight Times Table as he forms the ultimate superhero team in the Museum of Superheroes. From Eight to Eighty, including new heroes Forty-eight, Fifty-six and Seventy-two, the Super Eights are ready to save the day with their catchy tune! 🎶💪 With the power fo Eight, your little one could master the Eight Times Tables with help from the Numberblocks!

episodes.title: Seventy-two's Super Surprise
episodes.desc: Numberblock Seventy-two has a super surprise for us all! Can you guess what it is? 1️⃣ She’s made up of 9 Eights 2️⃣ She uses square power to defeat Octonaughty 3️⃣ She is a super heroic super-sneezer 4️⃣ All of the above 🏖️ Join Octoblock, Octonaughty and Seventy-two for tons of number fun antics on the beach!

episodes.title: The Magical Nines
episodes.desc: Raise your hands if you, your little one, and the entire family love magic shows! ✨ In The Magical Nines, Ninety hosts a magic show to teach the Numberblobs all about the Nine Times Table. With a wave of his wand, he reveals an amazing trick and a pair of wooden hands. 🪄 Get ready for heaps of new number fun with the Numberblocks!

episodes.title: Nine's Time to Shine
episodes.desc: 🆕 Time to embrace the greys with the Nine Times Table! 🩶 🎶 “I’m the Nine Times Table, the Nine Times Table, I’m here to cheer for Nine! The Nines might be grey like a rainy day, but this is their time to shine.” ☀️ Don't miss Nine's Time to Shine on the Numberblocks YouTube channel.

episodes.title: Space Division
episodes.desc: There’s always more to explore with numbers, so it’s never a goodbye, just a see you later! ❤️ In our series finale, Space Division, One Hundred assembles a team to investigate a mysterious signal and uses the Times Tables to fit into the 10 by 10 hyper-booster grid. Will your little one be a brave Number Explorer and join the Space Division to investigate a mysterious signal from the depths of space with their best friends, the Numberblocks and the Times Tables? 🛰️ 🚀 New Numberblocks adventures, here we come! ♥️❤️

episodes.title: The Third Button
episodes.desc: Detective One helps Three solve the case of the missing button, which Three desperately needs for her juggling practice. One tracks down all of her movements of where she was and when, reading simple o'clock times from various watches and clocks. As she uncovers Three’s jammy situation it’s another successful case closed for Detective One.

episodes.title: The Great Bug Race
episodes.desc: It’s Numberland’s Grand Zoombug Race, and One to Four are getting ready to race their pet bugs. Twenty helps to measure the tracks, showing the Numberblocks that their bugs must follow the perimeter. Using his string tape measure, he shows them the rules for measuring the perimeter of squares and other shapes. But will the zoombugs be able to run all the way around?

episodes.title: The Big Picture
episodes.desc: When Seventeen leads One to Four in an outdoor art class, Three insists on having the biggest canvas! So, Seventeen sets them a challenge to measure the size of their canvases using shapes. Sticking on shapes is fun, but they soon discover that, when you want to measure area, some shapes are better than others.

episodes.title: Space Repair
episodes.desc: One is replacing missing tiles on the Space Satellite high above Numberland. With the help of Twenty and the Area Repair Expert Assistant, can she find the perfect fit for each panel to complete their mission and power up the satellite in time for the Pattern Palace Light Show?

episodes.title: Capacity for Magic
episodes.desc: It’s time for the mysterious magic show, hosted by The Three Threes. Using jugs and cups, they dazzle the audience with the amount of stuff that fits inside any container tall or wide and teach them a new word - Ca-pa-city!

episodes.title: How Many Smoothies?
episodes.desc: Five’s new smoothie cafe is open and ready for business but Four and One mix up the orders of banana smoothies. How will they sort things out and get the order right for Five’s thirsty customers?

episodes.title: Odd Block Club
episodes.desc: At the Odd Blocks Clubhouse, Numberblocks One, Three, Five, Seven and Nine have gathered to celebrate being odd numbers, but One worries that she isn’t an odd block because she can’t see how she fits the pattern. Her Odd Block friends help her to see just how important she really is, because without One there would be no Odd Blocks at all!

episodes.title: Five Makes a Wish
episodes.desc: Five wishes to fly up to the stars, but she doesn’t have enough blocks to get there. She tries adding different Numberblock friends, but no-one can make her tall enough to reach the sky. Can Five figure out what she needs, to reach the star and make a wish?

episodes.title: Number Rescue, Go!
episodes.desc: The Numberland Rescue team have come together to sort out problems for their Numberblob friends. One of the Numberblobs needs help getting to sleep, whilst some of the other Numberblobs have missed the circus. The Numberblocks pair up to help solve these worries, and put things right. Just when they think all the rescues have been completed they get one final alert - a Numberblob, in urgent need of a birthday party. How will Three and Seven save the day?

episodes.title: The Best House Band in Numberland
episodes.desc: In this musical episode, Numberblocks Six, Seven, Eight, Nine and Ten sing about parts and wholes and the numbers that they have inside them.

episodes.title: Double Duets
episodes.desc: It’s time for karaoke in Numberland and a nervous One discovers that doubling yourself is a great way to have a friend by your side and make singing twice as fun!

episodes.title: Double Doors, Double Locked
episodes.desc: In the double doors challenge, Numberblocks One to Five must open every lock to pass a test. With the help of the Super Special Secret Step Squad they learn all about doubling and using the ‘Five and a Bit’ method. It’s going to be double the fun.

episodes.title: The All-knowing Nine
episodes.desc: Nine is performing at the Numberblocks theatre, but he worries that the Numberblobs are bored with his act. With the help of his friends he finds new ways to add numbers, leading to an epic finale.

episodes.title: Subtraction Somersaults
episodes.desc: Thirteen wants to join the Subtraction Somersault Team but only knows how to take away Three. At Ten’s Place gym, Ten explains how to take numbers away using two methods. By bridging the ten, Thirteen learns how to subtract his numbers and learn a new skill.

episodes.title: Tenpin Tournament
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks are at a bowling championship, competing in teams of two to win a trophy. Their friend Rekenrek helps to keep track of the scores, but who will win? Will it be the 'Rainbow Rollers', 'Team Two-wide' or someone else?

episodes.title: Five's Super Sorter
episodes.desc: Numberblocks Five and Two are in their toy library, but all their favourite toys are in a mess. Can their new friend Sorty the Super Sorter help sort out their problem?

episodes.title: Back in the Box!
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks have fun counting as they tidy up after games, but One finds it hard to keep track of everything. The friends use tally marks to fix their problem!

episodes.title: Five's Fruit Festival
episodes.desc: Five is having a fruit festival, but isn’t sure how much fruit she’ll need. Luckily Four finds a solution to her delivery needs.

episodes.title: I'll Vote for That!
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks have so many fun ideas for what to play, that it's hard to choose what to do next! Ten suggests they all vote. But what is a vote?

episodes.title: The Pyramid of Puzzles
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks explore a mysterious pyramid full of bar charts. They must read the clues in the charts to discover the pyramid's secrets - and to find their way out again!

episodes.title: One's Fix-it Shop
episodes.desc: One uses her brand-new workbench and her special goggle to help her friends put the parts of their broken toys back together again. Will she be able to help them all?

episodes.title: Happy Campers
episodes.desc: One and Two are off on a camping trip, and together they have fun sharing things equally between them. Can they carry on sharing things fairly when Three and Four join them?

episodes.title: The Mystery of Fraction Island
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks are exploring Fraction Island. Why are there four islands, when their map shows one? Will the Fraction Friends they meet help them solve the mystery?

episodes.title: Fractions Are a Piece of Cake
episodes.desc: One has been invited to the Fraction Friends party and first meets One Whole. How will the friends share the party food? Luckily they have a song that helps them work it all out!

episodes.title: Octonaughty and the Fractionator
episodes.desc: Octonaughty uses his new invention, the Fractionator, to break into The Museum of Numbers to steal the Golden Infinity. But has he met his match when he splits Octoblock into four equal parts?

episodes.title: You're Five Ones and I'm Five Tens
episodes.desc: Superstar Fifty sings a song that shows Five the pattern that makes them similar in so many ways and how, If you can count to five, you can count to fifty!

episodes.title: The Forest of Tens
episodes.desc: Thirty-Six and Forty-Five are exploring the Forest of Tens, on a quest for Ten. But what is the special something they need to find and bring to Ten?

episodes.title: All the Numbers I Can Be
episodes.desc: One is in awe of how many numbers One Hundred has inside. But exactly how many are there? One Hundred takes her on a journey to find out.

episodes.title: The Rings of Unity
episodes.desc: The Numberblocks Space Division are investigating a signal - until a strange planet splits them into hundreds, tens and ones. How can they escape?

episodes.title: The Space Signal
episodes.desc: At last, the Numberblocks Space Division has reached the mysterious space cloud that’s been sending out a signal. What’s hiding inside?

episodes.title: Go!
episodes.desc: Meet Wonderblock Go as she gets everything and everyone moving! When Go arrives, she leaps into action, magically making birds fly, flowers grow, instruments play, the rain fall and the stars shine. It’s a lot of fun, but is everything moving all at once such a good idea?

episodes.title: Stop!
episodes.desc: Meet Wonderblock Stop, Go’s new best friend! Stop likes to stop and think things through. When Go gets her ball stuck in a tree, Stop encourages her to pause for a moment to find a way to retrieve it. During their journey, Stop realises that taking a step back can help her find solutions to challenges in all sorts of places. Now, she is able to help her friends solve their problems too!

episodes.title: Hop!
episodes.desc: Go and Stop are playing in the forest when they meet Little Frog. When Little Frog shows them her favourite move - hopping, something magical happens... a Do Block appears, and the Do Block is called Hop! Go, Hop and Stop discover that when they join hands, Wonder Magic happens. It makes Little Frog leap high into the air. And when Little Frog leaps onto some springy moss using Wonder Magic, she hops up into the apple tree and makes the delicious apples tumble down. There are enough apples for everyone!

episodes.title: Moo!
episodes.desc: 🐮 Wonderblocks fans are guaranteed to be a-moo-sed by this NEW Wonderblocks episode! Cow is the guest singer in the latest performance by the Lilypad Band, but she can't quite get the timing of her moo right. 🎶 Using Wonder magic, Go, Stop and Do Block Moo help Cow to moo in exactly the right place! Watch the brand NEW episode, Moo!

episodes.title: Cluck!
episodes.desc: 2025's break-out star... Secret Agent Chicken! 🐔 Too cool for school! Children learn all about passwords and cracking codes with Secret Agent Chicken, Go, Stop and Do Block Cluck! 😎

episodes.title: Mooving Up
episodes.desc: ✨ Go ➡️ Moo ➡️ Cluck ➡️ Stop ✨ In the Wonderblocks episode Mooving Up, children learn that Wonder Magic can include more than one Do Block or action instruction. In creating Wonder Magic, Go - Moo - Cluck - Stop, Cow and Chicken can make their elevator go up! 🐔🐮🆙

episodes.title: Splat!
episodes.desc: Meet Arty the Artist, who loves to make a SPLAT! Go, Stop and the Do Blocks help Artie learn about patterns and sequencing. 🌈 They work together to decide when to 'go,' 'hop,' or 'splat' on the stones, creating a unique and colourful pattern.

episodes.title: The Breakfast Bears
episodes.desc: Do you ever encourage your kids to stop and ask themselves, "What do we want to end up with after we've all helped?" 🤔 The Three Bears are on a breakfast mission! 🐻🐻🐻 Your little learners will join Go, Stop, and the Breakfast Crew to figure out the correct sequence of instructions to achieve the perfect breakfast order. Enjoy the latest episode of Breakfast Bears

episodes.title: Moo! Cluck! Baa!
episodes.desc: 📣 The Animal Sound Challenge! 🐔🐮🐑 Test your animal sounds with this fun family game! 🎤 See if you and your children can sing along and match the correct Do Blocks with the animal sounds. 🎵 Stay on your toes and follow the sequence on the board!

episodes.title: Dancefloor Delights
episodes.desc: Go and Stop meet Arty and discover a disco dancefloor made up of four square tiles. It’s decked out with speakers and fairy lights. But how do you get the disco to start?

episodes.title: Step by Stepping Stone
episodes.desc: The Moving Crew, Go and Stop help Arty and the Little Hoppers figure out the right way to hop across the stepping stones to reach the other side of the muddy stream.

episodes.title: Rainy Day Bears
episodes.desc: ☔️ The Three Bears are ready for a rainy day adventure! 🐻 But first, they need to figure out the right order to get ready to go outside. Is ✨ Go ➡️ Put on Boots ➡️ Open Umbrella ➡️ Put on Socks - Stop ✨ the right sequence?! Wonder Explorers will learn about the importance of sequencing as the Do Blocks Rainy Day Crew experiment with different options. 🌧️

episodes.title: Tower of Flowers
episodes.desc: Sometimes it helps to think differently! ❤️ Bringing together lessons about colours, pattern making, and sequences, Artie helps Go make a lovely banner for Toad. 🌈 Activity! Get a piece of paper and draw half of a pattern of splats: red, blue, red, blue... Can your Wonder Explorer spot the pattern and complete the sequence? 🔍

episodes.title: Building Sandcastles
episodes.desc: Are your family ready for a spe-shell day at the beach in Wonderland? 🐚 What sequence of actions does your Wonder Explorer use to build a sandcastle? 🏖️ With the help of Go, Stop, and the beach Do Blocks, The Three Bears learn that different-sized buckets need different amounts of sand. 🪣 Can your family solve this puzzle and figure out how many scoops are needed for each bucket?

episodes.title: First Things First
episodes.desc: "Order is important or you'll go nowhere fast!" - Wise words from Go and Stop for Wonder Explorers small and big. 🤗 🧑 Bringing together lessons from throughout the series, the finale episode summarizes the different approaches and sequences as a way of problem-solving different things. "First things first, next things next, last of all comes last."

episodes.title: What Can We Do?
episodes.desc: Everyone is ready to watch the movie on Film Night. Except Secret Agent Chicken who’s meant to start the movie!

episodes.title: Woodland Wiggle
episodes.desc: Cow is learning a new dance – The Woodland Wiggle. Can she do all the moves in the right order?

episodes.title: Magic Beans
episodes.desc: Go and Stop are given some magic beans and discover that they can make amazingly shaped plants. But which ones look the best?

episodes.title: Musical Bears
episodes.desc: The band are too ill to play in the show, so The Three Bears step in to help – without being sure how to play the instruments!

episodes.title: Sounds Like a Plan
